text:
Casey (sales): Medixia POC ask: steady ~150 qps chat (avg ~40 tokens/resp) + occasional embedding spikes to ~500 qps for short windows. Need recommended reserved GPU commit, burst handling, autoscale policy, and any security blockers (KMS + long-term audit retention).

Toni (solutions): POC is 3 weeks, VPC peering is acceptable. They prefer quantized model variants where possible. Attached short trace shows 2x-3x spikes lasting 2-5m every 4-8h.

Matt (eng-runtime): Quick back-of-envelope: 150 qps * 40 tokens -> 6k tokens/sec steady. On our A100-like profile, 1 GPU ~220-260 qps for short responses when warm. Recommend reserve 2 GPUs baseline (min=2) and allow up to 2 burst GPUs (max=4).

Olivia (sre): Ops recs: autoscale min=2 max=4 cooldown=120s. Preheat KV cache before expected ramps (3m). Place baseline GPUs across AZs to avoid single-AZ loss.

Casey (sales): How do burst credits work and how are they billed?

Matt (eng-runtime): Burst credits allow short-term capacity above reserve. POC: we can permit trial burst usage. For enterprise commit: reserved covers baseline, burst billed at higher minute-rate. Pricing will give a blended quote line.

Evan (security): On questionnaire: confirm KMS support and audit exports. Medixia requested 7-year retention. We support exports to S3/BigQuery and can discuss retention via Legal. VPC peering acceptable for POC; on-prem would change guidance.

Olivia (sre): Runbook bullets: 1) KV preheat 3m prior to expected spikes. 2) Canary policy: 5% traffic -> ramp over 10m. 3) On AZ failover, shift traffic to remaining GPUs; consider immediate temporary burst to avoid 429s.

Matt (eng-runtime): Example autoscale config to drop into the deal doc:

```
autoscale:
  min: 2
  max: 4
  target_qps_per_gpu: 180
  cooldown_seconds: 120
  kv_preheat_seconds: 180
  burst_policy: allow_with_quota
```

Casey (sales): Medixia asked about tail latency (95p) during cold starts.

Matt (eng-runtime): Cold start penalty: ~300-800ms depending on model & KV state. With preheat + cache warm, expect p95 ~350-450ms for chat. Embeddings p95 typically <200ms unless CPU bound during huge spikes.

Evan (security): I'll draft questionnaire responses for KMS, log export paths, and retention options; will cc Legal for 7y retention exception.

Toni (solutions): I'll confirm kickoff date (aiming next Tue) and that they accept 2 baseline GPUs + burst to 4 for the POC. I'll attach the trace to the ticket.

ops-bot: Reminder created ticket #POC-7821 (assigned Toni).

Casey (sales): Action items: Matt -> two-line hardware + autoscale rec for quote; Evan -> questionnaire draft; Olivia -> ops runbook checklist; Toni -> confirm dates and attach trace. Will update customer once items are in. :thumbsup:
